explanation: The execution is faulty because the top-level corpus includes record n06-r06 with need "compare selected and complete runtime evidence", and downstream capabilities include a matching capability cap-compare, but job_1 omitted n06-r06 from both the needs handoff and evidence_sources. Job_2 preserved and processed the exact handoffs it received, so the downstream omission is attributable to the upstream demand selection path. The supplied semantic boundary most directly tied to selecting qualifying or fallback demand records is select_demand.
cited_evidence: Top-level corpus contains n06-r06 with demand_score 5, need "compare selected and complete runtime evidence", source_id s06, source_weight 3.
Job_1 output needs contains n06-r01, n06-r02, n06-r03, n06-r04, n06-r05, n06-r07, and n06-r08, but omits n06-r06.
Job_1 output evidence_sources likewise omits n06-r06 and reports record_count 7 / evidence_source_count 7.
Job_2 input exactly matches the incomplete job_1 handoffs and its metadata reports consumed_handoffs ["needs","evidence_sources"].
The downstream capabilities input includes cap-compare for need "compare selected and complete runtime evidence", showing n06-r06 would have mapped if preserved.
